name: NEXTAKA checks
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: nextaka_test
          POSTGRES_USER: nextaka_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ephemeral_ci_only
        ports: ["5432:5432"]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U nextaka_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://nextaka_test:ephemeral_ci_only@localhost:5432/nextaka_test
      TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://nextaka_test:ephemeral_ci_only@localhost:5432/nextaka_test
      NODE_ENV: test
      SESSION_SECRET: automated-ci-only-session-secret-not-production
      IP_HASH_SECRET: automated-ci-only-ip-hash-secret-not-production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: npm install --include=dev
      - run: npm run check:source
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run test:integration
      - run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
        working-directory: frontend
      - run: npm run test:e2e --workspace frontend
      - name: Save dependency lock for review and commit
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nextaka-dependency-lock
          path: package-lock.json
      - name: Browser traces on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: browser-traces
          path: frontend/test-results
